description: The 13 December Amman march is documented by Jordan Times, but it calls for Arab/international action and aid crossings, praises Jordan, and supplies no attendance figure.
required_followup: Check permitted independent reports for any demand to Jordan and a simultaneous turnout estimate.

description: The 6 December Safa report combines separate city marches/vigils, including an Amman symbolic funeral for two perpetrators of an armed Dead Sea attack. It also reports calls for effective protection measures, but per-site size, organization and domestic target are unresolved.
required_followup: Separate local actions only with evidence of organization and demands; distinguish the public gathering from the armed attack and resolve whether it protested the funeral prohibition or demanded broader state action.

description: The 20 December Amman march has hundreds reported and explicit Jordanian policy demands. No report in the reviewed scope establishes government response, violence, event closure, or whether repeated Friday marches form one continuous episode.
required_followup: Seek post-event and adjacent-month reporting; treat Boycott4Pal only as a search lead until opened and do not create duplicate candidate from same-day coverage.

description: Four captured queries included broad English/Arabic, focused labor and late-December searches, but no systematic LexisNexis, newspaper archive or full December weekly census was available.
required_followup: Run additional local/regional weekly and sector-specific searches, and document any inaccessible archives without claiming zero events.

description: The repeated Friday-march pattern in November and December may contain separate events or a continuing campaign. The saved reports do not establish onset/end boundaries across months.
required_followup: Compare organizers, demands, routes and intervals across November/December and check January 2025 before assigning episode endings.
